product_version: Prometheus remote write docs; Grafana Mimir latest; Thanos tip Compactor, checked 2026-10-05
version_sensitive_claims: Q1: Grafana Mimir uses X-Scope-OrgID tenant header, supports per-tenant ingest overrides and series limits; Prometheus remote write WAL queue can lose unsent samples after long receiver outage.
Q2: Thanos Compactor creates downsampled blocks and has retention per resolution; downsampling can increase object storage when raw is retained.
Q3: Mimir query-scheduler uses round-robin tenant fairness; frontend can split, shard and cache queries.
Q4: Mimir ruler stores per-tenant rules and warns high-cardinality evaluations may exceed evaluation interval.
staleness_risks: Architecture choices and SLOs are examples, not promised defaults of Prometheus, Mimir or Thanos.
